title: Bee Factory!
description: Bee Factory is a Modpack about Automating bees from forestry using create, and other mods!
body:
Bee Factory is a silly little modpack about automating bees from forestry using mods such as..
-Create
-The whole mekanism series
-AE2
However, when you get far enough, you can start genetically modifying bees with the Gendustry add-on for forestry.
